body.statement: Under polynomial-time promise-preserving many-one reductions on the finite encoding in \(\mathrm{def:source-encoding}\), \(\mathsf{SEL\mbox{-}PNQF}\) is \(\exists\mathbb R\)-complete and \(\mathsf{coSEL\mbox{-}PNQF}\) is \(\forall\mathbb R\)-complete. The reduction establishing the source normal form supplies \(z_Q\), forces \(x_{s_Q}\in\{0,1\}\) on the entire real solution set, and makes its uncomplemented YES predicate exactly the existence of a solution with \(x_{s_Q}=1\).
body.justification: The lemma fixes the reduction source, promise, and polarity before any SEM gadget is invoked.
body.gap: The real-complexity compendium supplies robust arithmetic normalizations, while the planted selector branch and its exact promise-complement convention must be recorded explicitly for this fiber reduction.
body.consumer: The hardness theorem can be read as a literal Karp reduction from a named unambiguous \(\forall\mathbb R\)-complete promise language.
